parts.label: (iii)
parts.answer: For $f(x)=\tan^{-1}\!\left(\frac{e^x}{\sin x}\right)-x$, $f(1)=0.27059$ and $f(1.5)=-0.14821$. Hence $f$ changes sign and $1<a<1.5$.
